content_filter: paraphrase-only; no >=25-word Burke verbatim; attributed term-glosses <=15 words OK

titular_redefinition.claim: Rhetoric's master term relocated from PERSUASION to IDENTIFICATION via dialectical raising of level of generalization (slaying = special case of transformation; transformation involves identification).
titular_redefinition.inseparability_close: persuasion + identification('consubstantiality') + communication('addressed') are one motive, cannot be kept apart (p.46)
titular_redefinition.intermediate_area_argument: identification captures the area between wholly-deliberate and wholly-unconscious that 'persuasion' cannot (RM-00 pp.xiii-xiv)

operational_definition.text: A is identified with B when their interests are joined, OR when A assumes/is persuaded they are joined, though A and B remain non-identical.

boundary_criteria: distinct from identity (both joined and separate, p.21) and from mere similarity (ground is shared act/substance)
ambivalently real-or-persuaded (p.20) — constitutive, not a defect (tension T1)
can operate without conscious design — by default / profitable malingering / self-address (pp.35-39)
compensatory to division — presupposes prior separateness (p.22)

variants_orders_of_identification.variant: addressed / self-address ('an I addressing its me', Mead)
ultimate identification (mystical union with universal order)

section_A_identification.dual_valence_tension: identification names BOTH genuine sharing of substance AND strategic/cunning masking of division; Burke holds both unresolved (RM-00 tension-03; RM-01 tension T1).

core_definition.text: To identify A with B is to make A 'consubstantial' with B: A is 'substantially one' yet 'remains an individual locus of motives' — 'both joined and separate, at once a distinct substance and consubstantial with another'.
core_definition.NOT: not identity; not mere similarity; a precise double structure (joined-AND-separate simultaneous)

act_basis.text: 'substance ... was an act; a way of life is an acting-together'; acting together men share sensations, concepts, images, ideas, ATTITUDES that make them consubstantial.
consequences: attitude is INTERNAL to it (seed of 6th term)

substance_abolished_as_term_retained_as_.text: 'substance' was abolished as a term by modern thinkers, but its FUNCTION cannot be abolished — 'a doctrine of consubstantiality ... may be necessary to any way of life' (p.21).
substance_abolished_as_term_retained_as_.load_bearing: licenses the FUNCTIONAL-not-lexical homology to Calleja (Section D); Calleja can perform the consubstantial function without naming 'substance'.

compensatory_to_division.text: 'Identification is affirmed with earnestness precisely because there is division. Identification is compensatory to division' (p.22).
compensatory_to_division.implication: consubstantiation is a RESPONSE to prior separateness — inherently dynamic, partisan, never static; division is its 'ironic counterpart'; rhetoric concerned with 'Babel after the Fall'.

paradox_of_substance_in_sacrifice.text: insofar as father and son are consubstantial, killing the son is simultaneous self-destruction and self-preservation ('simultaneous losing-and-having'); Christian sacrifice is the perfect paradigm.
paradox_of_substance_in_sacrifice.extends: consubstantiality from shared standing (RM-01) into enacted communal ritual (Rattlesnake Club: kill is occasion not essence, p.266).

link_to_grammar_paradox_of_substance.trilogy: Grammar=substance (universal paradoxes); Rhetoric=identification (partisan classification); Symbolic=identity (unique individuals at peace) (pp.21-23).
grammar_seeds_consolidated: GM-00 p.xix 'A may become non-A ... consubstantial with non-A'
GM-13 irony peripety (A returns as non-A)
link_to_grammar_paradox_of_substance.discharges: Grammar manual Section-E pending-future-rhetoric-of-motives-pipeline flag (see Section D + rm-pentad-extension-patch).

section_C_social_motive_apparatus.note: interlocking system: hierarchy generates mystery; mystery is courtship's suasive resource; courtship's tension + hierarchy's guilt discharge in the kill. Burke exposition burke-direct; Calleja mapping anticipatory-projection.

mystery.burke_direct: rhetorical condition wherever different KINDS of beings communicate across a structural divide; requires strangeness AND possibility of communion; objective structural effect of hierarchic difference, not subjective feeling (RM-03 p.115, pos-04). Mystification (Marx, dyslogistic) = mystery (Carlyle, eulogistic); Burke refuses to adjudicate, equates mystery with class distinctions (RM-03 p.122). Mystery intrinsic to persuasion as such (RM-04 pos-05).

hierarchy.burke_direct: universal motivational-symbolic principle (higher/lower), inevitable in systematic thought, reversible at level of pure principle, generator of courtship/mystery/mystification (RM-04 pos-01). Sub-concepts: entelechial principle (top-stage as image of whole, pos-06); hierarchic psychosis; competition as out-imitation (Veblen's invidious = special case of imitation = consubstantiality-by-community-of-ways, pos-02); homo dialecticus (classifying animal prior to social hierarchy, RM-07 p.283). RM-05: positive->dialectical->ULTIMATE vocabulary; god-term as 'principle of principles' ranking motives vs 'parliamentary jangle' (pos-02).

calleja_anticipatory.examples: leaderboards/tiers/gear-score as hierarchic-psychosis; entelechial pull to top rank; ultimate win-condition/god-term orders all positive-token optimization.

courtship.burke_direct: suasive devices for transcending social estrangement; rhetoric wherever different social kinds communicate across mystery of hierarchic difference (RM-06 p.208); NOT primarily sexual but structural. Paradigm=Castiglione's Courtier (symmetrical dialectical ascent); caricature=Kafka's Castle (access-seeker never gains access). Hazing/initiation (pp.235-238); reversibility of social and religious reverence (p.233). Tension T1: exploits the gap it seeks to bridge.

kill_pure_persuasion_ultimate_identifica.burke_direct: Order-Secret-Kill triad: hierarchy -> guilt -> victimage (scapegoat/katharma, sacred-and-loathsome) (pp.252-266, 328-329); kill is OCCASION not essence, essence = participation in solemn shared experience (Rattlesnake Club p.266). Pure persuasion = appeal for satisfaction intrinsic to saying; hallmark = self-interference/standoffishness ('a persuasion that succeeds, dies', pp.267-274). Ultimate identification = identification at dialectical limit = mystical union, dissolution into boundless being, 'end of all desire' (pp.328-333).

kill_victimage.rationale: ranked invidious distinction -> resentment -> toxic scapegoating; Rattlesnake Club = competitive-community formation & fracture.

pure_persuasion.rationale: autotelic play/flow; self-interference = difficulty calibration; Keats-Urn perpetual approach without consummation.

ultimate_identification.rationale: KEYSTONE culminating mapping; mystic composite isomorphic with deepest incorporation.

section_D_consubstantiation_incorporatio.status: DISCHARGES the Grammar manual's consubstantiation_pipeline_status: 'pending-future-rhetoric-of-motives-pipeline' (gm-pentad-operationalization-manual Section E).
section_D_consubstantiation_incorporatio.why_grammar_could_not_consolidate: 'consubstantiation' is Rhetoric-of-Motives (1950) vocabulary, not Grammar (1945) vocabulary; Grammar had only seeds (GM-00 p.xix; GM-02 type-16; GM-13 peripety). Calleja side independently flagged it 'theoretically rich and exegetically inadmissible' (Burke absent from Calleja).
section_D_consubstantiation_incorporatio.what_RM01_supplies: the missing burke-direct textual ground (p.21 definition; p.21 act-basis; p.22 compensation-to-division); RM-07 supplies the apex (pp.328-333).
section_D_consubstantiation_incorporatio.a_what_consubstantiation_means: burke-direct (D.1). A substantially one with the other yet a distinct locus; both joined and separate; act-based; compensatory to division; function survives abolition of the term.

b_homology_three_alignments.calleja_incorporation_def: (paraphrased, IG-10 p.169) absorption of a virtual environment into consciousness (yielding a sense of habitation) as supported by systemically-upheld embodiment of the player in a single avatar-represented location; rubric R1 assimilation / R2 embodiment / R3 simultaneity / R4 spatial+kinesthetic cornerstone / R5 blending.
alignments: Burke 'A is substantially one with' the other  <->  Calleja AXIS 1 / R1 assimilation (environment INTO consciousness)
Burke 'yet remains a distinct locus of motives; both joined and separate'  <->  Calleja AXIS 2 / R2 embodiment (player INTO environment via avatar = the distinct locus)
Burke both-joined-AND-separate held simultaneously  <->  Calleja R3 simultaneity condition (one in act yet two in being)
Burke 'acting-together makes men consubstantial'  <->  Calleja R4/R5 spatial+kinesthetic cornerstone + blending (consubstantiality is co-action)
Burke 'ultimate identification — dissolution into boundless being' (RM-07 p.333)  <->  Calleja incorporation at its fullest (peak state)
b_homology_three_alignments.homology_character: FUNCTIONAL, not lexical (Calleja never says 'substance'; Burke never says 'embodiment'); licensed by tension T2.

c_five_divergences.burke: symbolic identification through shared SUBSTANCE (property, interests, ideology, 'Belonging' p.28)
c_five_divergences.calleja: phenomenological ABSORPTION through 6 dimensions, spatial+kinesthetic cornerstone (R4)

c_five_divergences.burke: ambivalently real-or-persuaded (p.20), can be strategic/cunning (RM-01 T1)
c_five_divergences.calleja: sustained-but-fleeting EXPERIENTIAL STATE, not a persuaded belief
experientialist gestalts + consciousness-as-construct (Lakoff+Johnson 2003 / Damasio 2000 / Dennett 1991); NOT Merleau-Ponty/Heidegger (absent from IG-10)

c_five_divergences.burke: symmetrical-in-structure but asymmetrically-DEPLOYED (rhetorician engineers A->B, often across unequal status p.48)
c_five_divergences.calleja: insists on BIDIRECTIONALITY vs the unidirectional-plunge metaphor
bounded to ergodic media that acknowledge presence/agency (Tetris fails R4 cornerstone)

d_grounds_player_identification_and_atti.guild_faction_playerbase: 'acting-together' + ''Belonging' is rhetorical' (pp.21,28) = substance-theoretic WHY beneath Calleja Shared (IG-06); Rattlesnake Club = enacted-ritual register.
